exposure: elective caesarean section at 38 weeks gestation following a course of corticosteroids
elective caesarean section at 39 weeks gestation
outcome: rate of admission to the neonatal intensive care unit for respiratory distress
cohort: 208 women with an indication for elective caesarean section
finding: Planning caesarean sections at 38 gestational weeks after a course of corticosteroids significantly reduced the number of emergency caesareans without increasing the risk of neonatal respiratory distress.
